svg.title: Stack and numbers. Next.js 16 with the App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Groq with openai/gpt-oss-120b pinned, Upstash Redis for rate limiting, caching and run permalinks, Vitest, deployed on Vercel. 171 unit tests with no network. The enforced Groq free tier limit for the pinned model is 8,000 tokens per minute (the docs advertise 6,000); it is a reasoning model spending 600 to 1,300 tokens per call before writing JSON. 48 items is the default model sample (CLASSIFY_MAX_ITEMS), the only knob that limits coverage, and only for the inductive layer. With no API keys at all, a run still collects, labels 100%, scores opportunities and cuts segments. Each run produces a coverage panel, a ranked opportunity table on two taxonomies, segment cuts, channel coverage, grounded Q and A, CSV, JSON and markdown exports, and a run permalink. Built by Aditya K. Koundinya.

div.p: With no API keys a run still collects, labels 100%, scores opportunities and cuts segments. A Groq key adds themes and grounded Q&A; Upstash adds permalinks.
